description: AdColony full-screen video / interstitial and rewarded ad network (now part of Digital Turbine). The SDK package name remained com.adcolony.sdk after the acquisition.

obfuscation.internal_prefix: single-letter alphanumeric (a, b, c, a0, b1, c1 ...) in the same com.adcolony.sdk package as the public API

methods.name: configure
methods.note: Main SDK init — all overloads (Activity/Application x with/without AdColonyAppOptions, incl. varargs). Real return type boolean; false = init failed → SDK disabled.

methods.name: requestInterstitial
methods.note: Static boolean (both overloads). Returning false means the interstitial request is not queued, so onRequestFilled never fires.

methods.name: requestAdView
methods.note: Static boolean (both overloads) — banner/MREC AdView request.

methods.name: setRewardListener
methods.note: Static boolean — rewarded-video flow; false = listener not registered.

methods.name: show
methods.note: Instance boolean — displays the fullscreen ad.

methods.name: isExpired
methods.note: Instance boolean — matches real return type; safe because requestInterstitial is stubbed so no live object is produced.

methods.name: destroy
methods.note: Instance boolean — tears down a banner/MREC AdView.

manifest_components.note: Fullscreen interstitial / rewarded video display activity (present in AAR manifest for 4.6.0 through 4.8.2).
Expanded banner / MREC AdView display activity (present in AAR manifest for 4.6.0 through 4.8.2).

protected_patterns.reason: Returns the AdColonyAppOptions object apps commonly chain-call (setUserID/setGDPRRequired) — null would cause NPE.
Returns the registered AdColonyRewardListener — some integrations dereference it; null would cause NPE.
Returns an AdColonyZone object the app may query for reward/zone metadata — null would cause NPE.
Returns the SDK version String; mediation adapters may parse it — do not null.
